itemList.description:
35 HP Single Stage Centrifugal type Dewatering pump
Technical Specifications
Pump Details:
Suction Size: 150mm
Delivery Size:150mm
Pump Body:  Cast Iron
Impeller: Cast Iron
Maximum Head: 26m
Maximum Discharge: 500 m3/hr 
Performance: 
AT NTP conditions at 3m suction Lift
Discharge:400 m3/hr
Head : 10-20m
Engine Details:
Type : 3 Cylinder, 4 strokes, Air cooled, DIESEL
Speed:1500-2300 RPM
Max output: 35hp@2300rpm
Power takeoff: Coupling
Starting System: Battery 12 V x 100AH
Fuel: Diesel
Fuel Tank Capacity: 100 Litres
Frame Details:
Type: Small Four Wheel Trolley
Material: Mild Steel                                                                                           Dewatering pump coupled with Diesel Engine inclusive of standard accessories such as suction pipe of 20m length & delivery pipe of 30m length of HDPE type with minimum pressure 10kg/cm2 along with suitable clamps and fixture in complete for installation and operation .The approved makes as mentioned in the technical specification of bid document
